profile.role_note: Echo Skill DPS; scales off Echo Skill DMG, a rare and hard-to-buff damage type.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Top Aero DPS for dedicated Echo Skill compositions; worth pulling alongside Qiuyuan, but her damage drops significantly outside Echo Skill teams.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Solsworn Ciphers (or Blazing Justice / Abyss Surges) + 5-piece Sound of True Name in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Nameless Explorer in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, ATK% 3-costs (one can be Energy Regen), ATK% 1-costs, and 150% Energy Regen — her passive converts ER above 125% into Echo Skill DMG.

ranked_weapons.name: Solsworn Ciphers
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. ATK%, 32% Echo Skill DMG amplification, and Echo Skill DMG ignores 10% DEF. A major power spike.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Justice
ranked_weapons.note: Strong Crit DMG stat stick; Liberation-DEF-ignore half is wasted on her.

ranked_weapons.name: Pulsation Bracer
ranked_weapons.note: 3.0 standard-banner gauntlet; Crit Rate and ATK% make it a surprisingly strong pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: Energy Regen substat feeds her ER-to-damage passive; the gap to the signature is smaller than usual.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: Liberation DMG bonus for her rotation opener; solid 4-star stat stick.

ranked_weapons.name: Marcato
ranked_weapons.note: Craftable ATK buff after Liberation; acceptable stopgap.

echo_sets.name: Sound of True Name
echo_sets.note: The Echo Skill DPS set; Nameless Explorer grants Aero DMG and 20% Echo Skill DMG Bonus.

echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: Older Aero set; still her best-in-slot-adjacent placeholder with the Feilian Beringal echo.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit; DMG-type bonuses are not worth rolling for since her scaling is Echo Skill DMG.
ATK% beats Aero DMG for her; swap one piece to Energy Regen if you can't hit the ER target from substats.

build.energy_regen_target: ~150% (her passive grants 2% Echo Skill DMG per ER above 125%; 150% = 50% bonus)

teams.name: Premium: Sigrika + Qiuyuan + Shorekeeper

members.name: Sigrika
members.note: Echo Skill nuke carry; pairs with Qiuyuan for dedicated Echo Skill comps.

members.name: Qiuyuan
members.note: Enables Sigrika's Echo Skill compositions; together they clear current Tower of Adversity competitively.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Healing, Crit buffs, and team-wide damage amplification with minimal field time.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Qiuyuan runs his Echo Skill sequence to stack buffs, then Sigrika enters: Echo Skill, Basics, skill into rune generation, empowered Heavy, and Liberation for the nuke window.

teams.name: Alternative: Phrolova + Qiuyuan + Sigrika

members.name: Phrolova
members.note: Builds Volatile Notes, enters Resolving Chord with Liberation, and summons Hecate.

members.name: Qiuyuan
members.note: Forte-fueled Heavy Attack strings and Liberation to feed the Echo Skill loop.

members.name: Sigrika
members.note: Closes the rotation with her rune combo and Empowered Heavy into Liberation.

teams.rotation: Phrolova opens with Basics and skill combos into Scarlet Coda and Liberation, Outro to Qiuyuan for his Forte/skill/Liberation sequence, then Sigrika finishes: Echo Skill, Basics, runes, empowered Heavy, and Liberation.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: Top Aero DPS and Echo Skill scaler; a single-target monster.

sequences.verdict: S0 is fully viable with Qiuyuan. S2 is the efficient stop, S6 the whale ceiling.

pull_path.why: Full Echo Skill DPS loop works at S0 alongside Qiuyuan.
+120% Forte Circuit multiplier and Divergent on combat entry — the biggest jump per pull.
Targets take 30% more DMG; Innate Gift? stacks add up to 60% amplification and 30% DEF ignore.
